document.name: Compact ESP32-C3 Desk Sensor
document.description: A compact desktop environmental and air-quality node featuring a sourced ESP32-C3-MINI-1 radio module on a custom carrier PCB, an isolated sensor daughterboard, an anodized orange tilt bracket, and an M3 × 12 socket cap screw.
document.provenance: AI generated conceptual assembly. Geometry, dimensions and specifications are illustrative; no CAD fit, wiring or hardware operation has been verified.

parts.name: Weighted Desk Base
parts.description: Machined aluminum desktop base with non-slip elastomer pads and pivot ears.
parts.role: Machined aluminum desktop base with non-slip elastomer pads and pivot ears.

parts.name: Custom Orange Tilt Bracket
parts.description: CNC-milled and anodized orange aluminum U-bracket that supports the sensor pod and receives the central M3 × 12 mounting screw.
parts.role: CNC-milled and anodized orange aluminum U-bracket that supports the sensor pod and receives the central M3 × 12 mounting screw.

parts.name: M3 × 12 Socket Screw
parts.description: Standard M3 × 12 socket head cap screw clamping the orange bracket to the weighted desk base.
parts.role: M3 socket cap screw, 12 mm nominal length.
parts.notes: Sourced NopSCADlib geometry, tessellated and centered in millimetres (Y up). Placement, finish and annotations are editable. Standard dimensions are preserved. Source CAD does not verify fit, wiring, load capacity or operation of this assembly. License: GPL-3.0.

parts.name: Lower Housing Tray
parts.description: Matte dark-gray polymer enclosure tray with PCB mounting bosses, side intake vents, and USB-C cutout.
parts.role: Matte dark-gray polymer enclosure tray with PCB mounting bosses, side intake vents, and USB-C cutout.

parts.name: Carrier PCB Assembly
parts.description: Custom 4-layer FR4 carrier board providing USB-C power, 3.3 V regulation, status LEDs, and host pads for the ESP32-C3-MINI-1 module and sensor header.
parts.role: Custom 4-layer FR4 carrier board providing USB-C power, 3.3 V regulation, status LEDs, and host pads for the ESP32-C3-MINI-1 module and sensor header.

parts.name: ESP32-C3-MINI-1 Radio Module
parts.description: Sourced Espressif ESP32-C3-MINI-1 Wi-Fi and Bluetooth LE module surface-mounted onto the carrier PCB.
parts.role: Official Espressif radio module CAD. Module only; not a complete development board.
parts.notes: Sourced Espressif geometry, tessellated and centered in millimetres (Y up). Placement, finish and annotations are editable. Standard dimensions are preserved. Source CAD does not verify fit, wiring, load capacity or operation of this assembly. License: CC-BY-SA-4.0 + KiCad exception.

parts.name: Mezzanine Sensor Header
parts.description: Dual-row 2.54 mm pitch board-to-board socket header isolating the environmental sensor from carrier PCB heat.
parts.role: Dual-row 2.54 mm pitch board-to-board socket header isolating the environmental sensor from carrier PCB heat.

parts.name: Environmental Sensor Daughterboard
parts.description: Dedicated sensor PCB carrying a precision temperature/humidity/VOC MEMS package, particulate optical chamber, and thermal isolation slots.
parts.role: Dedicated sensor PCB carrying a precision temperature/humidity/VOC MEMS package, particulate optical chamber, and thermal isolation slots.

parts.name: Ventilated Upper Housing Shell
parts.description: Snap-fit top cover featuring a raised circular louvered intake dome over the sensor daughterboard and a front status light-pipe window.
parts.role: Snap-fit top cover featuring a raised circular louvered intake dome over the sensor daughterboard and a front status light-pipe window.

steps.title: Mount Orange Bracket to Desk Base
steps.description: Align the custom orange tilt bracket between the pivot ears of the weighted desk base and secure it through the central bore using the sourced M3 × 12 socket screw.

steps.title: Install Lower Housing Tray
steps.description: Fasten the matte lower housing tray onto the top saddle of the orange bracket.

steps.title: Populate Carrier PCB & ESP32-C3-MINI-1
steps.description: Mount the custom carrier PCB onto the four housing bosses, with the sourced ESP32-C3-MINI-1 radio module positioned at the RF keep-out zone.

steps.title: Stack Isolated Sensor Daughterboard
steps.description: Fit the mezzanine sensor header onto the carrier PCB and seat the environmental sensor daughterboard above the thermal isolation gap.

steps.title: Close Ventilated Upper Shell
steps.description: Snap the ventilated upper housing shell onto the lower tray so the louvered dome sits directly above the environmental sensor.

relationships.description: M3 × 12 socket cap screw passes through the lower web of the orange tilt bracket.
M3 × 12 screw threads into the central boss of the weighted desk base.
Orange bracket pivots between the ears of the weighted desk base.
Top saddle of the orange bracket supports and fastens to the lower housing tray.
Lower housing tray supports the carrier PCB on four internal standoffs.
ESP32-C3-MINI-1 radio module is surface-mounted to the carrier PCB pads for power and I/O.
ESP32-C3-MINI-1 polls environmental telemetry from the sensor module over I2C.
Mezzanine header solders to the carrier board and routes 3.3 V and I2C lines upward.
Environmental sensor daughterboard plugs into the mezzanine socket header.
Ventilated upper housing shell snaps onto the lower housing tray to enclose the electronics.
